resolved.title: 链表
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Linked List [/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A [b]linked list[/b] is a sequence of nodes where each node stores its own data and a link to the next node.
One node links to another forming what can be thought of as a linked chain: [img id="3225" width="100%"]
The first node is called the [b]head[/b], and it's used as the starting point for any iteration through the list. The last node must have its link pointing to [b]None[/b] to determine the end of the list.

Unlike stacks and queues, you can insert and remove nodes in any position of the linked list (similar to a standard list).

[s0l0!-header][h2]Applications[/h2][/s0l0!-header] 

Linked lists are useful when your data is linked. For example when you need undo/redo functionality, the nodes can represent the state with links to the previous and next states. Another example would be a playlist of music, where each clip is linked with the next one.
[note]Linked lists can also be used to create other data structures, such as [b]stack[/b], [b]queues[/b] and [b]graphs[/b]. [/note]

content.text:
一个 **链表** 是一个节点(node)序列，其中每个节点都存储了自己的数据和与下一个节点的链接(link)。
一个节点链接到另一个节点，形成可以被认为是一个链接。
content.text_html:
A linked list is a sequence of nodes where each node stores its own data and a link to the next node. One node links to another forming what can be thought of as a linked chain:

一个链接的列表是一个节点序列，其中每个节点都存储了自己的数据和与下一个节点的链接。 一个节点链接到另一个节点，形成可以被认为是一个链接链。

content.text:
第一个节点被称为**头**(head)，它被用来作为列表中任何迭代的起始点。最后一个节点的链接必须指向**None** ，表示列表的结束。

与栈(Stack)和队列(Queue)不同，你可以在链表的任何位置插入和删除节点（类似于标准列表）。

**应用**:

当你的数据有链接特性时，链表很有用。例如，当你需要撤销/重做功能时，节点可以代表状态，并与上一个和下一个状态链接。另一个例子是一个音乐播放列表，其中每个片段都与下一个片段相连。

Applications

resolved.title: python中实现链表
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Linked List in Python[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Each node will include [b]data[/b] and the [b]link[/b] to the next node.

Let's start by creating the [b]Node [/b]class:[code format="py" ]class Node:
  def __init__(self, data, next):
    self.data = data
    self.next = next[/code]
Now we can create the [b]LinkedList[/b] class with the corresponding methods:[code format="py" codeId="3126"]class LinkedList:
  def __init__(self):
    self.head = None
    
  def add_at_front(self, data):
    self.head = Node(data, self.head)      

  def add_at_end(self, data):
    if not self.head:
      self.head = Node(data, None)
        return
    curr = self.head
    while curr.next:
      curr = curr.next
    curr.next = Node(data, None)

  def get_last_node(self):
    n = self.head
    while(n.next != None):
      n = n.next
    return n.data

  def print_list(self):
    n = self.head
    while n != None:
      print(n.data, end = " => ")
      n = n.next
    print()[/code]
The [b]add_at_front[/b]() method adds a new Node as the head of the list and links the previous head to it.
The [b]add_at_end[/b]() method iterates to the end of the list using a while loop and adds the new node as the link of the last node.
[note][b]Run the code[/b] and see how it works![/note]

resolved.title: 音乐播放器
resolved.problem_statement_md:
你正在编写一个音乐播放器，它允许你创建一个曲目的播放列表。
给定的代码定义了播放器**Player**和曲目**Track**类，其中**Player**是一个链表，将**Track**对象链在一起。

该代码从用户输入中获取一些曲目，并将它们添加到播放列表中。

你需要遍历迭代链表，并按照播放顺序输出播放列表中的所有曲目。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Linked List[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are making a Music Player, which allows you to create a playlist of tracks.
The given code defines [b]Player[/b] and [b]Track[/b] classes, where the Player is a linked list, chaining together Track objects.
The code takes a number of tracks from user input and adds them to the playlist.

You need to iterate over the linked list and output all the tracks in the playlist in the order of playback.
[note]Use a [b]while[/b] loop to iterate over the linked list.[/note]
